subject: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@olivetech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech

Sarah — great to get the signed SOW across the line. Attaching the initial mutual action plan (MAP) and the signed SOW for your records. High-level asks from the sales side:

- Target go-live window: week of Sep 13 (customer preference for a mid-September pilot)
- Minimum viable scope: real-time embeddings + query reranking for support KB; API integration via our hosted endpoints
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 350ms, cost per 1M tokens < $X (we'll reconcile based on production traffic)

Internal asks for CS/Implementation: please confirm primary owners for CSM/Implementation, estimate sprint-0 duration, and any initial infra or security gating items (VPN, allowlist IPs, any data residency flags).

Attachments: OliveTech-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW_OLIVETECH_signed.pdf

Next step: can we lock a 30–45 minute kickoff the week of Aug 9? I'll follow up with a few time slots.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@olivetech.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech

Thanks Marcus — looping in Tessa for scheduling and Monica for implementation scoping.

Monica: quick context for you (short): OliveTech signed the SOW for hosted inference + embeddings + reranking. Expected traffic initially modest (prototype queries ~5k/day), with an aggressive plan to double in Q4. They are in the US, no EEA data residency requirements at sign but may request logs retention controls.

Can you: 
- Confirm you can own Implementation lead (Monica)
- Estimate Sprint-0 (discovery + test harness) in days, and a rough staffing ask (1 engineer + 0.5 PM FTE typical)
- Call out any blockers (VPC, KMS, SOC2 evidence requests) you need up-front

Sarah — Monica will coordinate pre-kickoff intake items. Tessa will propose kickoff times.

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@olivetech.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech

Ack — I can take Implementation lead. Quick read-through notes from the MAP:

- Sprint-0: 10 business days for discovery + test harness (includes sample ingestion, baseline evals, and a small-scale embedding index)
- Required from OliveTech before sprint-0: API keys for a sandbox service account OR an allowlist of integration IPs; representative KB export (CSV or JSON, ~10–50 docs for initial tuning); primary technical contact (Diego Ruiz noted below)
- Security ask: they requested SOC2 Type II evidence and baseline RBAC details — we can provide our SOC2 report; if they want network-level proofs (VPC peering), that will push timeline (estimate +3 weeks)

I'll prepare a Sprint-0 runbook (using deployment-checklist-template.docx) and share a tailored MAP with owners filled in by Monday.

Monica
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@olivetech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech

Thanks Marcus and team. Confirming: Diego Ruiz (diego.ruiz@olivetech.com) is our technical lead and can gather the KB sample and sandbox credentials. We prefer hosted endpoints and do not require VPC peering at this stage. SOC2 report would be appreciated.

Kickoff window week of Aug 9 works for us — mornings PT are best. Suggested agenda: 1) Introductions + roles, 2) Sprint-0 scope & deliverables, 3) Access & security checklist, 4) Success metrics & reporting cadence.

—Sarah
Head of AI Platforms | OliveTech

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@olivetech.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan, owners, and kickoff timing — OliveTech

Thanks — proposing two kickoff slots: Tue Aug 10 09:30–10:00 PT or Wed Aug 11 08:30–09:00 PT. Please pick one or suggest alternatives.

Attached: sprint-0-runbook (draft), SOC2-summary-redwood.pdf link (see related_links).

Pre-kickoff checklist (short):
- Diego: share a 10–25 doc KB export to SFTP or Drive by Aug 6
- OliveTech security: confirm who will receive SOC2 PDF and whether they need a redacted version
- Redwood: Monica will publish the Sprint-0 runbook and fill owner columns; Karthik to provide test harness template

Once slot confirmed I will send calendar invites and a short kickoff deck.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
